name: Apparel Style Wise Sales
query:
SELECT
  sii.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  asm.style_code as "Style Code:Data:120",
  asm.style_name as "Style Name:Data:150",
  SUM(sii.qty) as "Qty Sold:Float:100",
  SUM(sii.amount) as "Amount:Currency:130"
FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent AND si.docstatus = 1
LEFT JOIN `tabApparel Style Master` asm ON asm.item = sii.item_code
WHERE asm.name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sii.item_code
ORDER BY SUM(sii.amount) DESC
